objectClass.primaryType: hannya mask — noh/kagura demon face shell
objectClass.notes: Depicts a face but is an OBJECT: no body, no skeleton, no hair, never deforms. The character track's landmark/anatomy/rig gates do not apply. Reference is an untextured clay preview, so it carries geometry evidence only — material evidence is declared not applicable rather than extracted from the clay.

reasoning: Silhouette is broken in three directions by paired appendages (horns laterally and superiorly, ears laterally and posteriorly) — not approximable as one ovoid.

The object is a THIN SHELL, not a solid: the rear view shows a continuous posterior rim and daylight through both the eye and mouth apertures. Wall thickness is a real geometric property, so a solid head would be wrong regardless of silhouette score.
Horns are swept 3D arcs: up and laterally (front), leaning back at the base (profile), tips curving forward (top). A tapered cone would pass a silhouette IoU and still be wrong.
Dentition carries identity: four fangs plus a row of ~6 rectangular incisors. These are a few pixels wide and need the microscope tier, not the 64x64 luma grid.
Occlusion risk is LOW rather than typical — six admitted views resolve the rear, the interior, the horn rake and the jaw underside that a single view would have hidden.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Observed structure, not a domain default: 3 macro assemblies (shell, horn pair, ear pair), 8 meso sub-assemblies, 5 micro feature groups, and one genuine repetition system (the incisor row along the maxillary arc).

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Left eye aperture: almond through-cut with raised outer canthus; interior visible — a real cut, not a dark patch.
Right eye aperture — reflection of eye-aperture-l across the median plane.
Mouth aperture: wide through-cut between the lips, corners raised; daylight visible through it from the rear view.
Two nostril cavities on the nose underside, flared laterally; confirmed from the below view.
Hard creases bounding the flat faceted plane between the brows; light breaks across real edges, not a normal map.
Brow crest ridgelines rising laterally into the angry V; positive relief catching a highlight on the crest.
Raised collar ring where each horn seats into the cranium — a socket seam, not a butt joint.
Row of ~6 rectangular incisors recessed behind the upper fang line — repeated small parts, an instanced system along the maxillary arc, never one-off meshes.
Paired folds from the alae to the mouth corners; positive relief with shadowed crevices medially.
Cheekbone planes meeting at hard creases — faceted, geometric transitions over the organic base.
Helix/antihelix/concha relief inside each pointed ear; raised curved features, not flat tabs. Better evidence in the profile view.
Continuous wall-thickness rim terminating the shell: cranium apex, behind the ear, around the jaw. Primary evidence is the rear view.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: wall-thickness [uncertain]: readable only at the rim (rear view), est 0.03-0.05 of head width +/-50% -> adopt 0.05 as a declared parameter; does not affect silhouette gates
interior-relief-depth [uncertain]: rear view shows a soft inverse of the face; depth unmeasurable -> model interior as inner-offset ellipsoid, declared approximation
rim-fillet [uncertain]: sub-pixel -> treat as hard edge, stated stylization
real-world-scale [undetermined]: no scale cue -> author in head-width units; consumer re-normalises to ~1 unit
finish [undetermined]: achromatic clay preview carries no finish evidence; tonal variation is lighting -> materials declared, not extracted; consumer overrides them
incisor-lateral-extent [occluded]: fangs occlude the row's lateral end in every view -> terminate at fang line, declared inference

definitionOfDone: The rendered model matches the reference silhouette, primary proportions, visible component hierarchy, material response, and most recognizable local features for the selected fidelity tier.

featureGroups.name: Horn pair — swept 3D arc
qualityCriteria: Each horn is a swept tube along a 3D curve with monotonic taper to a point, NOT a cone.
Front view: rises and splays laterally. Profile: base leans posteriorly. Top: tip curves anteriorly.
Tip-to-tip span ~1.85x head width; tips rise ~0.24x head width above the cranium apex.
The pair is a reflection across the median plane, with triangle winding flipped.
failureModes: horn built as a straight tapered cone (passes silhouette IoU, fails the arc gate)
horn base butt-joined to the skull instead of seated in its raised collar
pair produced by rotation instead of reflection

featureGroups.name: Hollow shell with through-cut apertures
qualityCriteria: A thin wall with a continuous posterior rim from cranium apex, behind the ear, around the jaw.
Eye and mouth apertures are cut THROUGH the wall — visible as daylight from the rear azimuth.
Interior is concave everywhere; no solid volume behind the face.
failureModes: a solid head that looks correct from the front and has no interior
apertures modelled as dark-painted recesses instead of through-cuts
rim terminating in an open boundary edge loop instead of a closed wall

featureGroups.name: Mouth aperture, four fangs, incisor row
qualityCriteria: Two upper fangs descend and two lower fangs ascend at the aperture corners.
A row of ~6 rectangular incisors sits recessed behind the upper fang line.
Aperture width ~0.46x head width; the row is a repetition system, not modelled one-by-one.
failureModes: fangs omitted or fused into the lip mass
incisor row absent — the single clearest identity marker after the horns
colour-gating the aperture, which is concave and reads cavity shading not material

featureGroups.name: Faceted brow V over almond apertures
qualityCriteria: Brow ridges meet in a hard V with a flat faceted plane between them.
Eye apertures are almond with the outer canthus raised; the ridge overhangs them superiorly.
Creases are geometric (plane meets plane), never a normal-map substitute.
failureModes: brow smoothed into the cranium, losing the faceting that defines the expression
eye apertures round instead of almond, or level instead of canted

featureGroups.name: Pointed lateral ears
qualityCriteria: Pointed, elf-like, embedded in the lateral wall posterior to the horn base, raked posteriorly.
Carry concha/helix relief, not flat tabs.
failureModes: ears omitted entirely (they were missed in the earlier hand-built attempt)
ears as flat extruded tabs with no concha

featureGroups.name: Cheekbone facets and nasolabial folds
qualityCriteria: Cheekbones are faceted planes meeting at creases; nasolabial folds run from the alae to the mouth corners.
failureModes: cheeks smoothed to a generic ovoid, flattening the expression

featureGroups.name: Nose wedge, bridge crease, nostrils
qualityCriteria: A wedge projecting anteriorly with a bridge crease continuing from the brow V; two nostril cavities on the underside.
failureModes: nose bridge rounded instead of creased

featureGroups.name: Measured proportions
qualityCriteria: Shell height 1.51, horn span 1.85, horn rise 0.24, mouth width 0.46 — all normalised to head width 1.00.
failureModes: proportions guessed rather than measured off the reference

visualDeltaChecks: silhouette and negative-space delta at 0/90/180/270 azimuth
horn arc curvature delta (swept_arc_gate) — not silhouette IoU
aperture through-cut delta: background enclosed inside the silhouette from the rear azimuth
dentition placement and scale delta on the visible footprint (microscope tier)
incisor repetition count and spacing delta
local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Filled from six admitted views. Geometry-only: material evidence is not applicable because the reference is an untextured clay preview.
